title: 第899章 事了回宗第898章 万族嗤笑
slug: 时空洞天三千法则铸无上
content_zh:
“柳惊天联手凌宇，直接横扫西南妖域！”
“四座妖族核心主城，尽数被连根拔除！”
“数百万妖族精锐全军覆没，死得干干净净！”
“妖族数十万载积攒的浩瀚根基，一朝清零！”
有人长叹一声，满眼唏嘘。
“五大修炼命脉尽数被毁，药田焚烧、灵脉断裂、宝库崩塌、祭坛碎灭、血池报废！”
“几座传承万古的妖城，彻底沦为毫无生机的废土！”
全场所有异族修士，此刻皆是满脸鄙夷。
“自作孽，不可活！”
“这就是最好的报应！”
“区区妖族，贪心不足蛇吞象！”
“放着安稳日子不过，非要挑衅绝对招惹不起的存在！”
“妄图算计人族天骄，践踏太虚宗的宗门威严！”
一名异族王侯冷笑着总结。
“最后怎么样？”
“半点便宜没占到，反倒惹了一身洗不掉的血海大祸！”
“赔了数百万族众性命，丢了四座主城，毁了万年传承根基！”
“哈哈哈，长生天这么多年，我就没见过这么蠢的种族！”
四面八方的异族议论声此起彼伏，嘲讽不绝于耳。
此战真相传遍长生天每一个角落。

曾经嚣张跋扈、处处挑事的西南妖族，彻底沦为整片万族的天大笑柄。
万族四处嘲讽、大肆讥笑妖族蠢笨无知、自毁根基的流言。
如同狂风骤雨一般，疯狂涌入长生天所有妖族疆域。
各大妖城残存的妖族修士听闻外界嘲讽，个个又怒又憋屈。
一处妖族残余据点之内，幸存的低阶妖修个个面色惨白，垂头丧气。
一名残存的妖王咬牙攥拳，眼底满是滔天怒火。
“可恶！可恨！”
“我妖族数十万载基业，四座主城，尽数毁于一旦！”
“数百万同族身死道消，五大修炼命脉彻底断绝！”
另一名老妖修浑身颤抖，声音沙哑无比。
“谁能想到……仅仅一次伏击，竟引来如此灭顶之灾。”
“我们不过想掠夺一尊人族天骄精血，借机族群突破。”
“怎么会落得根基尽毁、被万族耻笑的下场！”
一旁坐镇此地的妖将满脸赤红，又气又恨，却只能无力捶胸。
“柳惊天！凌宇！”
“此二人毁我妖族半壁西南疆土，此仇不共戴天！”
content_en:
"Liu Jingtian joins forces with Ling Yu to directly sweep through the Southwest Demonic Territory!"
"The four core main cities of the demon clan have all been uprooted!"
"Millions of elite demon clans were wiped out and died cleanly!"
"The vast foundation accumulated by the demon clan for hundreds of thousands of years was wiped out in one fell swoop!"
Someone let out a long sigh, eyes full of regret.
"All the five major cultivation lifelines were destroyed, the medicine field was burned, the spiritual veins were broken, the treasure house collapsed, the altar was shattered, and the blood pool was scrapped!"
"Several demon cities that have been passed down for eternity have been completely reduced to lifeless wasteland!"
All the foreign monks in the room were filled with contempt at this moment.
"It is your own fault and you will not live!"
"This is the best retribution!"
"It's just a monster clan, greedy enough to swallow an elephant!"
"Let's just live a peaceful life. If you insist on provoking someone, you definitely can't afford to offend him!"
"An attempt to plot against the genius of the human race and trample on the majesty of the Taixu Sect!"
A foreign prince concluded with a sneer.
"How did it end?"
"I didn't get the slightest advantage, but instead caused a bloody disaster that can't be washed away!"
"We lost the lives of millions of clan members, lost four main cities, and destroyed the foundation of our ten thousand-year inheritance!"
"Hahaha, in all these years of Changshengtian, I have never seen such a stupid race!"
Discussions of aliens from all directions were heard one after another, and ridicule was endless.
The truth of this battle spread to every corner of Changshengtian.
The Southwest Monster Clan, which was once arrogant and domineering and always causing trouble, has completely become the laughing stock of the entire tribe.
All races are ridiculing and ridiculing the rumors that the demon race is stupid, ignorant, and self-destructive.
Like a violent storm, it crazily poured into all the demon clan territories in Changshengtian.
The remaining demon monks in the major demon cities were angry and aggrieved when they heard the ridicule from the outside world.
In a remaining stronghold of the demon tribe, the surviving low-level demon cultivators all looked pale and dejected.
A remaining demon king gritted his teeth and clenched his fists, his eyes filled with monstrous rage.
"Damn it! Hateful!"
"Our demon clan has hundreds of thousands of years of foundation and four main cities, all of which were destroyed in one fell swoop!"
"Millions of our kindred spirits have died, and the five major cultivation lifelines have been completely cut off!"
Another old demon cultivator was trembling all over and his voice was extremely hoarse.
"Who would have thought that... just one ambush could lead to such a disaster."
"We just want to plunder the essence and blood of a human race genius and take advantage of the tribe's breakthrough."
"How could he end up with his foundation completely destroyed and ridiculed by all races!"
The demon general sitting on the side was red in the face, angry and hateful, but could only beat his chest powerlessly.
"Liu Jingtian! Ling Yu!"
"These two people destroyed half of our demon tribe's southwest territory. This hatred is irreconcilable!"
